[[File:Heavy_Targeting_Optics.png|thumb|right|200px|[[Canderous Ordo]] wearing Heavy Targeting Optics]]
'''Heavy Targeting Optics''' were an advanced optics and targeting system that was worn as a mask. It attached to hand-held weapons, such as rifles and heavy weapons, and provided targeting information, distance and tracking of potential targets within the user's line of sight.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
